mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_trace ( trace_id, root_span_id, task_id, request_id, app_id, workflow_version, conversation_id, invoke_source, status, finish_reason, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, total_cost, span_count, model_call_count, input_data, output_data, trace_data, error_data, error_code, error_message, gmt_create, gmt_modified ) VALUES ( #{entity.traceId}, #{entity.rootSpanId}, #{entity.taskId}, #{entity.requestId}, #{entity.appId}, #{entity.workflowVersion}, #{entity.conversationId}, #{entity.invokeSource}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.finishReason}, #{entity.startTime}, #{entity.endTime}, #{entity.durationMs}, #{entity.promptTokens}, #{entity.completionTokens}, #{entity.totalTokens}, #{entity.totalCost}, #{entity.spanCount}, #{entity.modelCallCount}, CAST(#{entity.inputData} AS jsonb), CAST(#{entity.outputData} AS jsonb), CAST(#{entity.traceData} AS jsonb), CAST(#{entity.errorData} AS jsonb), #{entity.errorCode}, #{entity.errorMessage}, #{entity.gmtCreate}, #{entity.gmtModified} )
